note: The size of the viewer bundle every reader downloads, gzipped: the viewer's own code and every dependency in it, together. Two numbers, because one cannot do both jobs (docs/viewer.md section 12). max_gzip_bytes is the CEILING, the claim about what the finished twelve-screen viewer costs a reader, set from arithmetic rather than from today's build so it does not move screen by screen. max_growth_gzip_bytes is the PER-CHANGE BUDGET: scripts/checks/bundle-size.sh --base compares the live build to the measured_gzip_bytes recorded on the merge base, so the figure a change is judged against is never in the branch being judged. measured_gzip_bytes is what the ci.yml viewer job produced on x86_64 Linux on the date below; another host emits slightly different bytes, well inside the budget. A change that grows the bundle records its own CI figure here, which moves the baseline by exactly one change.

bars.claim: the finished viewer's WebAssembly module is under 460 KiB gzipped, and no one change adds more than a whole screen's worth
the wasm-bindgen bootstrap is under 12 KB gzipped
the compiled Tailwind sheet is under 8 KB gzipped
